userStories.title: Write ADR 0049: the Garboard naming policy
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need an ADR in docs/adr/ recording the complete Garboard naming policy (product name, canonical binary, typed alias, legacy symlink, canonical GitHub org, staged rename plan) so that the naming decision is durable, reproducible from the repo alone, and supersedes only the naming-deferral clause of ADR-0045 while reaffirming its display-only doctrine.
acceptanceCriteria: A new ADR file exists in docs/adr/ at the next free number, 0049. [oracle: file-assert ls docs/adr/0049-*.md] [red-on-main: measured exit 1 against unmodified main, swept 2026-07-26]

The ADR names every element of the policy: product name Garboard (the garboard strake, first hull plank laid against the keel, structural-foundation metaphor), canonical binary garboard, single typed alias gar (typed, not spoken; garb rejected as longer, gbd rejected as a classic gdb typo), cam demoted to an undocumented legacy symlink, canonical GitHub org garboard-run. [oracle: file-assert f=$(ls docs/adr/0049-*.md 2>/dev/null) && test -f "$f" && for t in Garboard garboard gar garboard-run symlink; do grep -qwi "$t" "$f" || exit 1; done] [red-on-main: measured exit 1 against unmodified main, swept 2026-07-26; grep -w verified NOT satisfied by the substring garboard for token gar]

The ADR records the staged rename plan (docs-only now, binary naming happens at launch packaging as a distribution item of launch-readiness, internal contracts CAM_* env vars / .cam-* state files / tmux -L cam socket / /cam-* slash commands / sentinels NEVER rename) and states that it supersedes ONLY the naming-deferral clause of ADR-0045 while explicitly reaffirming ADR-0045's display-only doctrine. [oracle: file-assert f=$(ls docs/adr/0049-*.md 2>/dev/null) && test -f "$f" && for t in "launch packaging" 0045 display-only; do grep -qi "$t" "$f" || exit 1; done] [red-on-main: measured exit 1 against unmodified main, swept 2026-07-26]

The ADR follows the repo ADR format: title line '# ADR 0049: ...' plus '## Context', '## Decision', '## Consequences' sections. Per repo convention (ADRs 0044 through 0048 carry no status field), presence in docs/adr/ IS the accepted status; the issue's 'accepted ADR' criterion is satisfied by the file landing in docs/adr/ in this format, and no explicit status line is required or expected. [oracle: file-assert f=$(ls docs/adr/0049-*.md 2>/dev/null) && test -f "$f" && grep -q "^# ADR 0049:" "$f" && grep -q "^## Context" "$f" && grep -q "^## Decision" "$f" && grep -q "^## Consequences" "$f"] [red-on-main: measured exit 1 against unmodified main, swept 2026-07-26]

The ADR's rationale is complete and self-contained: it passes the three ADR gates (hard to reverse, surprising without context, genuine trade-off with real alternatives), restates (never merely cites) every fact taken from the machine-local Downloads source docs and the CAM-408..CAM-416 epic descriptions, records namespace-availability facts always with their verification date (they expire), keeps third-party product claims factual and non-disparaging, and notes that GAMBREL (4-round champion) was demoted with its own kill evidence. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

No em dash appears in the new ADR (operator formatting rule for human-readable persisted markdown). [oracle: file-assert f=$(ls docs/adr/0049-*.md 2>/dev/null) && test -f "$f" && ! grep -q '—' "$f"] [red-on-main: measured exit 1 against unmodified main, swept 2026-07-26; existence-guarded so a missing file can never pass vacuously; discriminator verified red on a synthetic em-dash file and green on a clean file]

No decorative emoji appears in the new ADR. userStories.title: Add the naming-decision section to docs/positioning.md
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need the naming-decision section of docs/positioning.md recording the 5-round process, the full kill evidence, the dated namespace measurements, the alias policy and the ranked reserves so that the naming rationale is auditable from the repo alone and future rename discussions start from evidence, not memory.

The section records kill evidence for every named killed candidate: Slipway, Ingot, Crivo, Assay, and the demoted 4-round champion Gambrel (GitHub org tombstoned: creation form says already taken while the API 404s on org and user; SERP dominated by gambrel roof, reproducing the CAM vs computer-aided-manufacturing SEO disease; sonority rejected by the operator).
